title.zh: 《The Witness》已在美洲和欧洲的 PSN 上架。
title.en: The Witness is now up on PSN in the Americas and Europe.

subtitle.en: Out now on PSN, with the Steam release expected the same morning.
subtitle.zh: PSN 版已经上架，Steam 版预计同一天上午放出。

translator.note: 第一段的源行是「照片 + 正文」混排，按 schema 保留为一个段落、图片标记按源顺序内联。

blocks.en: ![图](http://the-witness.net/news/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/CZodCbOW0AEYvbs-1.jpg)It should go up on Steam this morning around 9 or 10am Pacific time.
blocks.zh: （原文此处有一张图）它应该会在今天上午太平洋时间 9 点或 10 点左右上架 Steam。

blocks.en: I made a posting on the PlayStation Blog: https://t.co/ChsVlBzhVw
blocks.zh: 我在 PlayStation Blog 上发了一篇帖子：https://t.co/ChsVlBzhVw
